title: A Polar Bear Isn't White: Its Fur Is Clear and Its Skin Is Black
subject: polar bear

scenes.text: A polar bear is not white. Not one hair of it.
Each guard hair is clear and hollow, like a tiny tube of glass.
The hairs scatter every color of light back at you, so the bear looks white.
Underneath, its skin is black, which soaks up the sunlight that gets through.
Fur and fat keep its body temperature normal even at minus 37 degrees Celsius, and it's nearly invisible to infrared cameras.
So what color is a polar bear? Clear on the outside, black underneath.

description:
